sql.value: SELECT sum(po.subtotal) as subtotalSum, po.product_id AS productId, po.quantity AS baseQuantitySum, jp.`name` as productName, ju.`name` as baseUnitName, jp.`code` as productCode, js.`name` as supplierName, jw.`name` as warehouseName FROM ( SELECT jpii.subtotal, jpii.quantity, jpii.base_unit_id, jpii.warehouse_id, jpii.product_id, jpi.supplier_id FROM jxc_purchase_inbound_item AS jpii LEFT JOIN jxc_purchase_inbound AS jpi ON jpii.purchase_inbound_id = jpi.id WHERE jpi.order_status = '已审核' and jpii.merchant_id = :merchantId #[ AND jpi.inbound_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] UNION ALL SELECT - jpri.subtotal as subtotal, - jpri.quantity as quantity, jpri.base_unit_id, jpri.warehouse_id, jpri.product_id, jpr.supplier_id FROM jxc_purchase_return_item AS jpri LEFT JOIN jxc_purchase_return AS jpr ON jpri.purchase_return_id = jpr.id WHERE jpr.order_status = '已审核' and jpri.merchant_id = :merchantId #[AND jpr.return_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] ) AS po LEFT JOIN jxc_warehouse AS jw ON jw.id = po.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN jxc_unit AS ju ON ju.id = po.base_unit_id LEFT JOIN jxc_product AS jp ON jp.id = po.product_id LEFT JOIN jxc_supplier AS js ON js.id = po.supplier_id WHERE jp.merchant_id = :merchantId #[AND (po.order_no like :filter OR js.name like :filter)] #[AND js.id = :supplierId] #[AND jp.id = :productId] #[AND jw.id = :warehouseId] group by @value(:groupBy)

select s1_0.name supplierName, w1_0.name warehouseName, sum(po.quantity) as baseQuantitySum, sum(po.subtotal) as subtotalSum, p3_0.id as productId, p3_0.name as productName, p3_0.code as productCode, u1_0.name as baseUnitName from jxc_purchase_return_item po left join jxc_purchase_return p2_0 on ( p2_0.id=po.purchase_return_id ) left join jxc_supplier s1_0 on ( s1_0.id=p2_0.supplier_id ) left join jxc_warehouse w1_0 on ( w1_0.id=po.warehouse_id ) left join jxc_unit u1_0 on ( u1_0.id=po.secondary_unit_id ) left join jxc_product p3_0 on ( p3_0.id=po.product_id ) where p2_0.merchant_id= :merchantId and p2_0.order_status='已审核' #[AND p2_0.return_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] #[AND (p2_0.order_no like :filter OR js.name like :filter)] #[AND p2_0.supplier_id = :supplierId] #[AND po.product_id = :productId] #[AND po.warehouse_id = :warehouseId] group by @value(:groupBy)

select sum(po.quantity) as baseQuantitySum, sum(po.subtotal) as subtotalSum, p3_0.name as productName, p3_0.code as productCode, p3_0.id as productId, u1_0.name as baseUnitName, s1_0.name as supplierName, w1_0.name as warehouseName from jxc_purchase_inbound_item po left join jxc_purchase_inbound p2_0 on ( p2_0.id=po.purchase_inbound_id ) left join jxc_supplier s1_0 on ( s1_0.id=p2_0.supplier_id ) left join jxc_warehouse w1_0 on ( w1_0.id=po.warehouse_id ) left join jxc_unit u1_0 on ( u1_0.id=po.base_unit_id ) left join jxc_product p3_0 on ( p3_0.id=po.product_id ) where p2_0.merchant_id= :merchantId and p2_0.order_status='已审核' #[AND p2_0.inbound_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] #[AND (p2_0.order_no like :filter OR js.name like :filter)] #[AND p2_0.supplier_id = :supplierId] #[AND po.product_id = :productId] #[AND po.warehouse_id = :warehouseId] group by @value(:groupBy)

SELECT po.secondary_price AS secondaryPrice, po.subtotal, po.secondary_quantity AS secondaryQuantity, po.order_no AS orderNo, po.orderDate, po.orderType, jp.`name` as productName, ju.`name` as secondaryUnitName, jp.`code` as productCode, jp.`name` as supplierName, jw.`name` as warehouseName FROM ( SELECT jpii.secondary_price, jpii.subtotal, jpii.secondary_quantity, jpii.secondary_unit_id, jpii.warehouse_id, jpii.product_id, jpi.order_no, '采购入库' as orderType, jpi.supplier_id, jpi.inbound_date AS orderDate FROM jxc_purchase_inbound_item AS jpii LEFT JOIN jxc_purchase_inbound AS jpi ON jpii.purchase_inbound_id = jpi.id WHERE jpi.order_status = '已审核' and jpii.merchant_id = :merchantId #[ AND jpi.inbound_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] UNION ALL SELECT jpri.secondary_price, - jpri.subtotal as subtotal, - jpri.secondary_quantity as secondary_quantity, jpri.secondary_unit_id, jpri.warehouse_id, jpri.product_id, jpr.order_no, '采购退货' as orderType, jpr.supplier_id, jpr.return_date AS orderDate FROM jxc_purchase_return_item AS jpri LEFT JOIN jxc_purchase_return AS jpr ON jpri.purchase_return_id = jpr.id WHERE jpr.order_status = '已审核' and jpri.merchant_id = :merchantId #[AND jpr.return_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate] ) AS po LEFT JOIN jxc_warehouse AS jw ON jw.id = po.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN jxc_unit AS ju ON ju.id = po.secondary_unit_id LEFT JOIN jxc_product AS jp ON jp.id = po.product_id LEFT JOIN jxc_supplier AS js ON js.id = po.supplier_id WHERE jp.merchant_id = :merchantId #[AND (po.order_no like :filter OR js.name like :filter)] #[AND js.id = :supplierId] #[AND jp.id = :productId] #[AND jw.id = :warehouseId]
